title: Beginner Friendly Watercolor Tutorial
description:
Follow along with the full tutorial: https://youtu.be/NqoXJmEKCU8

This project celebrates the wet-on-wet technique in watercolor, which is probably one of the funnest and unique aspects of watercolor. While painting this I want you to let loose, have fun, and really celebrate the magic that's within your watercolors! 

#sarahcray #letsmakeart #watercolorstepbystep #watercolortutorial #watercolorforbeginners
